Count C(12,6)=924 >= exp((ln2)/16*144)=512 exact. Separation valid: distinct balanced diagonals differ in m>=2 coords, HS distance-squared=4m/12>=8/12=2/3, so sqrt(2/3)>>eps0=1/10.
